tools.name: consulter_marchand
tools.description: Full test result for ONE French online store, by domain: what an AI shopping agent managed to do there at the latest test. Use it before visiting, recommending or buying from a French store, or when the user asks if a store works with AI agents. To find stores you do not know yet, use trouver_marcha

tools.name: classement_secteur
tools.description: Ranking of ALL tested French online stores in one sector, best score first. Use it when the user wants the best stores of a sector as a whole (for example the best beauty stores for an AI agent). To filter by proven facts such as guest checkout, use trouver_marchands; for the details of one store, c

tools.name: rechercher_marchand
tools.description: Find a tracked French store by part of its NAME or DOMAIN, across all sectors (case and accents ignored). Use it when the user names a store but you do not know its exact domain; then call consulter_marchand with the domain found. To discover stores by criteria rather than by name, use trouver_march

tools.name: trouver_marchands
tools.description: Discover French online stores where an AI agent can actually buy, filtered by PROVEN facts, in one sector or all of them. Use it when the user asks where to buy something online in France, which stores allow guest checkout, or which show the delivered price. To look up a store by name, use recherche

tools.name: comparer_marchands
tools.description: Side-by-side test results for two to five French online stores you already know, in the order given. Use it when the user hesitates between specific stores. To find candidates first, use trouver_marchands or rechercher_marchand. Returns: marchands, one full result per store, identical to consulter_m

tools.name: verifier_site
tools.description: Live check of ANY online store, tracked by Neoavis or not: can an AI shopping agent read it without clicking? Reads the UCP checkout profile (/.well-known/ucp), structured product data, robots.txt access for shopping agents, llms.txt and sitemap, in a few seconds. Use it when the user wants to buy f

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "consulter_marchand" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Full test result for ONE French online store, by domain: what an AI shopping agent managed to do there at the latest test. Use it before visiting, recommending …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: consulter_marchand, verifier_site · Public sink: classement_secteur.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: consulter_marchand, verifier_site · Public sink: classement_secteur

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "consulter_marchand" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
